source: InDesign 2025 20.5.5.119 (Windows), measured 2026-11-12 by windowmenu-c1: DOM + UI Automation reads + guarded real clicks (realinput.py) + screenshots of the document window. Tools: artifacts/windowmenu-c1-20261023/tools (m1, m3, m5, m10, m12).

controls.name: Refresh
controls.enabled: Highlight is not None and Auto Refresh Highlight is off

controls.name: Preset
controls.note: the choice stays when the panel is hidden or the document is closed (application state, not document state)

writes.printPreferences.ignoreSpreadOverrides: the Ignore Spread Overrides check box

spreadOverride.ignoreOff: Outlined Text, Outlined Strokes and All Rasterized Regions painted nothing (the preset High painted the shadow before)
spreadOverride.ignoreOn: Outlined Strokes: K2 only; All Rasterized Regions: shadow of D and the L3/image overlap; Outlined Text: the page shown as pastel (original colours mixed 50% with white), not grey
spreadOverride.unresolved: why; measure again with an override made in the UI

refresh.editWithAutoRefreshOff: the highlight stays as it was (stale) until Refresh is pressed
refresh.editWithAutoRefreshOn: the highlight follows the edit (checked after 3 s); the Refresh button is dimmed

highlightDrawing.idea: The page is shown ghosted (everything grey, half way to white); the objects the mode selects are painted on top in red.
highlightDrawing.ghost: g = 255 * (1 - 0.5 * min(1, 0.30*C + 0.59*M + 0.11*Y + K)), C M Y K as fractions 0..1 of the composited ink at the pixel, drawn as R=G=B=g

samples.what: opaque red C0 M100 Y100 K0 alone
multiply magenta over cyan (C100 M100), highlighted
opaque yellow under the 50% blue, mode All Affected Objects

modes.note: Test page: A opaque, B opaque under C, C 50% opacity, D drop shadow, E multiply over F, G text above E, H stroke above C, K1 text under L, K2 stroke under L, L 50% opacity, K3 gradient under L2, K4 image under L3. Table = what is painted red. Presets Low and Medium gave the same picture on this page.
modes.None: no ghost, the page as it is

high: shadow of D (soft edge, the shadow area only; D itself stays grey)
K1 text (the glyphs, not the frame)
notAffected: A, I, J (nothing transparent touches them)
All Affected Objects.rule: an object whose paint comes before (below) a transparent object that overlaps it is affected as a whole; objects above the last transparent object of the area are not

Outlined Strokes.note: strokes are converted to outlines in the Low and Medium presets

Outlined Text.note: no preset converts text to outlines; a spread override set through the DOM (convertAllTextToOutlines=true, flattenerOverride=CUSTOM) did not change it (unexplained, see rules)

Rasterized Complex Regions.note: nothing on this page in any preset (needs content that is complex enough: not found yet)

low: overlap of L3 and the image K4 (the intersection only, not the whole image)
All Rasterized Regions.note: the gradient under L2 is not rasterised even in Low
